descriptionFull: The Caspian tern ( Hydroprogne caspia ) is a species of tern, with a subcosmopolitan but scattered distribution. Despite its extensive range, it is monotypic of its genus, and has no accepted subspecies. The genus name is from Ancient Greek hudros , "water", and Latin progne , "swallow". The specific caspia is from Latin and, like the English name, refers to the Caspian Sea.
